title: [master][Bug]: Page 615 "IC Inbox Transactions".RunInboxTransactions
summary: Page 615 'IC Inbox Transactions' now correctly shows the request page for users with more than basic permissions, fixing a conditional check that was preventing the page from opening properly.
key_points: Changed IsFoundationEnabled check to IsBasicOnlyEnabled for proper permission validation
Request page now opens for users with permissions beyond basic
Tests updated to handle the request page by clicking OK
Fixes intercompany inbox transaction processing for elevated user roles
Changes affect multiple localization layers (CH, CZ, NL, W1)
quote: Changes the check of IsFoundationEnabled to IsBasicOnlyEnabled, such that the request page opens when the user is more than basic.
